title: The Pale Horizon
author: Oscar Vane
blurb: Vesper Thornbury, an insurance investigator of impossible accidents, has spent three years hauling cargo through contested orbits. But when the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
